_about: Public-domain Daniel Rowland (1713-1790), Welsh Calvinistic Methodist preacher of Llangeitho, for the Word Hoard: his English sermons, Eight Sermons upon Practical Subjects (1774) and Three Sermons upon Practical Subjects (1778), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 50 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

rowland-eight-sermons: Eight sermons, upon practical subjects; preached at the new church in Langeitho, South Wales; by the Rev. Mr. Daniel Rowland: and now attempted to be translated from the original British.  1774 (catalogued 1774)
rowland-three-sermons: Three sermons upon practical subjects, ... Preached at the New-church in Langeitho, South-Wales. By the Rev. Mr. Daniel Rowland, ... And now attempted to be translated from the original British. By the Rev. John Davies, ...  1778 (catalogued 1778)

_alternates.rowland-copies: The second 1774 copy and the 1788 Eight Sermons

_excluded.rowland-other: Welsh-language sermons and hymns (1743-1792) left for Adam's ruling on Welsh; Owen's Memoir of Daniel Rowlands (1840, another author)
